meta.name: google-ads
meta.description: Manage Google Ads — performance, keywords, bids, budgets, negatives, campaigns, ads, search terms, QS, location targeting, bulk operations, experiments, asset management, portfolio bidding, offline conversions. Use for any mention of Google Ads, CPA, ROAS, ad spend, or campaign settings.

copy.tagline: 管理谷歌广告投放与优化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责谷歌广告账户的日常管理与效果提升。
copy.tagline_en: Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Google Ads accounts and want to improve performance.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以管理 Google Ads 账户：查看广告效果、调整关键词出价和预算、暂停或修改广告系列、添加否定关键词、创建实验、管理资产（如附加链接）以及上传离线转化数据。
howto.when: 当你提到 Google Ads、广告系列、关键词、出价、预算、CPA、ROAS、搜索词、否定关键词、广告效果、地理位置定位、实验或广告系列设置等话题时触发。

say.text: 帮我查看上周的广告系列效果。
say.note: Claude 会拉取数据并总结关键指标。

say.text: 把“运动鞋”关键词的出价提高到 2 元。
say.note: Claude 会执行出价更新并返回 changeId。

say.text: 为搜索广告系列创建一个实验，测试新的出价策略。
say.note: Claude 会创建实验并添加实验组。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage Google Ads accounts: view ad performance, adjust keyword bids and budgets, pause or modify campaigns, add negative keywords, create experiments, manage assets (like sitelinks), and upload offline conversions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Google Ads, campaigns, keywords, bids, budgets, CPA, ROAS, search terms, negative keywords, ad performance, location targeting, experiments, or campaign settings.

say_en.text: Show me last week's campaign performance.
say_en.note: Claude will pull data and summarize key metrics.

say_en.text: Increase the bid for 'running shoes' keyword to $2.
say_en.note: Claude will update the bid and return a changeId.

say_en.text: Create an experiment for the search campaign to test a new bidding strategy.
say_en.note: Claude will create the experiment and add experiment arms.
